name: Jamin
title: Son of Simeon and founder of a clan
summary: Jamin was the second son of Simeon, Jacob's son, and one of those who accompanied Jacob to Egypt. He became the ancestor of the Jaminites, a clan within the tribe of Simeon. Although he does not play a prominent individual role in the biblical narrative, he is important as part of Israel's tribal history.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among the sons of Simeon
keyEvents.description: Jamin is listed as the second son of Simeon in the genealogy in Genesis.

keyEvents.title: The Genealogy in Exodus
keyEvents.description: Jamin is mentioned again among the sons of Simeon in connection with the overview of the sons and clans of Israel in Egypt.

keyEvents.title: Descent to Egypt with Jacob's Family
keyEvents.description: Jamin was among the 70 people in Jacob's household who went down to Egypt during the famine, marking the beginning of Israel's stay there.

keyEvents.title: The Jaminite Clan in the Census
keyEvents.description: In the census in Numbers, the Jaminites are mentioned as one of the clans within the tribe of Simeon, showing that Jamin's descendants became a significant family group.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in 1 Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Jamin is listed in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles as one of the sons of Simeon, confirming his place in Israel's tribal history.
